The vendor directly providing **Cognito Forms** at **cognitoforms.com** is **Cognito, LLC**.

### Evidence
According to the official [Terms of Service](https://www.cognitoforms.com/terms) for Cognito Forms at `cognitoforms.com`:
> *"Cognito Forms (“Cognito Forms” or the “Service”) is an online form building service offered through the URL www.cognitoforms.com... Cognito Forms is owned and operated by Cognito, LLC, a South Carolina limited liability corporation (“Cognito Forms,” “we,” or “us”)."*

This is also corroborated by the [Privacy Policy](https://www.cognitoforms.com/privacy), which states that the policy applies to *"websites and services provided by Cognito, LLC (“Cognito Forms”, “us” “we” or “our”)"*.
